title: decode.rs: three separate *_was_limited flags instead of a single enum
description: decode.rs uses three separate bool flags (b64_input_was_limited, qp_input_was_limited, identity_was_limited) where only one can ever be true at a time (only one TransferEncoding branch executes). Suggested rewrite: replace the three bools with a single 'input_was_limited: bool' initialized to false, then each branch sets it. The current pattern forces the reader to understand that the three are mutually exclusive.
